title: A shop day that turns a profit
target: How to spend a shop day so the day's takings pay for the next delivery, using only the shop behaviour the game defines.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)

steps.do: Open packs before opening hours rather than during them.
steps.because: an automatic opener exists for bulk opening and keeps its own progress (InteractableAutoPackOpener, AutoPackOpenerSaveData)

steps.do: Price what you opened before it reaches a shelf.
steps.because: price tags are separate objects applied to goods (InteractableCardPriceTag)

steps.do: Fill the shelves, because a shelf only sells what it holds.
steps.because: shelf contents are tracked by a manager (ShelfManager)

steps.do: Put the day's profit into one upgrade at a time.
steps.because: upgrades are a defined set of choices reached from the expansion screen (EUpgradeType, ExpansionShopUIScreen)

commonMistakes: Opening packs during opening hours and leaving the counter empty.
Shelving cards that have not been priced.
Buying decoration before you have stock.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
